lines.zh: 我的四个蹄子，一点声音都没有。
lines.en: My four hooves make no sound at all.
My eyes are red, no whites.
I'm far bigger than any dog.
I walk along the wall and don't look back.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方，温度会掉。
lines.en: The temperature drops where I pass.
I walk steadily, as if on patrol.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上一敲一敲。
lines.en: My claws tap the floor, one two.

lines.zh: 我绕着这一层走了一圈。
lines.en: I circle this floor once.
I reach the junction and stop.
I take the left-hand one.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛是红的，没有眼白。
lines.en: My eyes are red, with no whites.

lines.zh: 我的红眼，在走廊尽头亮着。
lines.en: My red eyes glow at the corridor's end.
Mud clumps in my coat.
You can hear me breathing.
I don't blink, not once.
I move an ear.
The corridor light flickers on my back.
Your gaze lands on my back.
It's far too fast.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子抬起来，闻了闻。
lines.en: I lift my nose and sniff.
There's only one of you on this floor.
I've counted this floor.
My tail hangs still.
My eyes glow yellow in the dark.
Nothing else ahead.
You're the only one on this floor.

lines.zh: 诅咒已经落进你的骨头。
lines.en: The curse has settled into your bones.
Then the count has begun.
Ten minutes from now.
Ten minutes is plenty for me.
You won't feel it.
But it's there.

lines.zh: 我这张脸，其实不太像狗。
lines.en: This face of mine isn't really a dog's.
Look long enough and something feels wrong.
I advise you to stop looking.
You're at the ninth minute already.

lines.zh: 你盯着我中心，就中了我的诅咒。
lines.en: Stare at my center and the curse takes you.
You haven't retreated a step.
That's a rare thing.
The result is the same.

lines.zh: 我嘴唇翻开，露出整排牙。
lines.en: My lip peels back off a full row of teeth.

lines.zh: 看了我一眼，你就带了诅咒。
lines.en: One look at me and the curse is on you.
You're sweating. I can smell it.
That smell is easy to know.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，眼睛没移开。
lines.en: I give half a step and don't look away.
That doesn't hurt.
There's blood in my fur.

lines.zh: 我四个蹄子落地，一点声音都没有。
lines.en: Four hooves land without a sound.
You got one hit. I've noted it.
It hasn't made you any safer.
I'm standing just fine.
My eyes are still red.
Hit me again. It's all the same.
My claws rake the ground.
That thing you're raising, I don't eat it.
I don't eat what you're holding up.

lines.zh: 你放下来，我就不看它了。
lines.en: Put it down and I'll ignore it.

lines.zh: 我绕着你，爪子不发出声音。
lines.en: I circle you; my paws make no sound.
You turn with me.

lines.zh: 转多了，你就会看我的眼睛。
lines.en: Turn enough and you'll look at my eyes.

lines.zh: 被我看一眼，你会中诅咒。
lines.en: One look from me and you're cursed.

lines.zh: 你手里那东西，挡不住诅咒。
lines.en: What you hold won't stop the curse.
It won't stop teeth either.
I only need to stand here a while longer.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，像撞一堵冷墙。
lines.en: You hit me like a cold wall.
My shoulder is hard as stone.
That left a cold on your hands.
The cold on me won't go away.
I step around your legs.
My fur brushed you.
You shivered.
You're shivering. Just so.
We'll do it again.
This time you moved aside.
There's no other like me on this floor.
I'm the only one.

lines.zh: 黑狗的伴侣，不需要誓言。
lines.en: A black dog's mate needs no vows.
Look at my center and be cursed.
I only need to look.
The more who look, the more there are of me.
That's my way.
Look at me too, and you'll understand.
Don't rush. Your turn will come.
I can wait. Can you?
I lower my head and take up a scrap of cloth.
It smells of you.
I set it on the floor.
And step on it.
That's my mark.
You'll step on it on your way out.
I pick up a key.
It's no use to me.
I drop it in the corner.
The key is in the corner. Go find it.
You've come up the stairs.

lines.zh: 别看我的中心，看就完了。
lines.en: Do not look at my center. It will finish you.
You haven't seen me.
I walk forward, into the light.
Now you see me.
You saw me and stopped.
Your hand reaches behind you.
There's a wall behind you.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子一寸寸挪过去。
lines.en: My hooves move over an inch at a time.
Not fast. No need to be.
All you have to do is look at me.
And you're looking already.
I stop three paces short.
Now comes the waiting.
I can wait longer than you think.
I'll wait for you to notice.
I stand between you and the way out.
Step by step I move sideways.
That way you'll have to turn your head.
At last you turned your head.
My eyes were right there.
You looked away.
You'll look again.
People always look again.

lines.zh: 我往前走一步，你后退了。
lines.en: I step forward and you step back.

lines.zh: 你退了半步，诅咒已经开始计时。
lines.en: You stepped back; the curse has begun counting.
And so we shift.
All the way to the corridor's end.
There's a mirror there.
You'll see me in the mirror.
A mirror would be much faster.
I'll wait by the mirror.
The mirror is right there.
You did look up, as expected.
I bite into the leg.
The bone in my mouth is brittle.
Only one bite.
The curse does the rest.
You kick and I step aside.
I lunge again from the other side.
I rake your arm once.
Three scratches, shallow.
They won't scab.
You press the wound.
Pressing the wound won't help.
I bite, then retreat into the dark.
You can't run fast now.
I'll follow behind you.
All the way to your door.
Until you come to a stop.

lines.zh: 我从走廊尽头的黑里走出来。
lines.en: I come out of the dark at the corridor's end.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头的黑，是我带进来的。
lines.en: The dark at the corridor's end came with me.
The tube light blinks twice and steadies.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子踩在地上，没有声音。
lines.en: My hooves touch the floor without sound.

lines.zh: 你看了我一眼，诅咒就落你身上。
lines.en: One look at me and the curse settles on you.
There's someone on this floor.
First I'll walk one slow circuit.
Memorizing every door.
I stop at the first one.
I stand still.
Someone inside is breathing.
I keep watch outside the door.
Sooner or later the door opens.
It always does.

lines.zh: 用户外的黑影里，我睁开眼。
lines.en: I open my eyes among the shadows outside.
A while more won't hurt.
In the dark there are only two red points.
Don't look this way.

lines.zh: 火舔过我的背，我低吼着退开。
lines.en: Fire licks my back; I growl and pull away.

lines.zh: 我从楼梯上摔下去，落地没有声。
lines.en: I fall down the stairs and land silently.

lines.zh: 水没到我背上，我照样走。
lines.en: Water to my back and I keep walking.

lines.zh: 炸响把我掀翻，我又站起来。
lines.en: The blast throws me over and I rise again.

lines.zh: 一枚子弹进了我的侧腹。
lines.en: A round goes into my flank.

lines.zh: 这道咒，把我的诅咒挡了一下。
lines.en: That spell blunted my curse for a moment.

lines.zh: 这层楼空了，我什么都没得吃。
lines.en: This floor's empty. Nothing to eat.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我连眼都没眨。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and I don't even blink.

lines.zh: 我往下掉，眼睛还是红的。
lines.en: I fall, and my eyes stay red.
